guitar.modelsText: G&L Rampage (early) / Gibson Les Paul (signature model)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Cantrell is well documented playing a G&L Rampage in early Alice in Chains years, later closely associated with Gibson Les Paul (his own signature model).
guitar.notes: Original entry correct and well documented.

tone.target: dry, heavy AIC grunge crunch with nasal lead bite
tone.profile: dry, heavy AIC grunge crunch with nasal lead bite
tone.summary: A high-gain chain using a pre-distortion boost (OD 9) into the UK 800 amp model, paired with a 4x12 cab, emphasizing mid-range punch and controlled darkness.

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum.
Add mid-forward grind and tighten the low end before high gain.
Provide the core dark, heavy grunge crunch without excessive fuzz.

improvements.summary: Refine the cabinet tone for better realism and grit, focusing on a darker, more aggressive sound suitable for AIC's grunge style.

proposals.reason: The current IR is too clean; needs more grit and darkness for AIC's heavy crunch.
